assertions.subject: Pulmonary Hypertension
assertions.quote: Pulmonary hypertension and congenital heart defects, particularly tetralogy of Fallot, are the leading causes of a dysfunctional pulmonary valve resulting in regurgitation

assertions.subject: Primary pulmonary hypertension
assertions.quote: Primary pulmonary hypertension primarily contributes to pulmonary regurgitation in adults

assertions.subject: Secondary or functional pulmonary regurgitation
assertions.quote: Secondary or functional pulmonary regurgitation develops in individuals with a structurally normal pulmonary valve but who exhibit severe pulmonary arterial hypertension

assertions.subject: Secondary or functional pulmonary regurgitation
assertions.quote: Secondary or functional pulmonary regurgitation develops in individuals with a structurally normal pulmonary valve but who exhibit severe pulmonary arterial hypertension and dilation of the pulmonary artery

assertions.subject: Idiopathic Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
assertions.quote: Pulmonary hypertension and congenital heart defects, particularly tetralogy of Fallot, are the leading causes of a dysfunctional pulmonary valve resulting in regurgitation
